title: Brandon Aubrey: Cowboys' contract offer is "not the ideal"

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Brandon Aubrey: Cowboys' contract offer is "not the ideal"
sources.description: The Cowboys are willing to make Brandon Aubrey the highest-paid kicker in the NFL, but they have stopped far short of the $10 million annual average he wants.
